title: Is your lunch costing the earth
paragraphs: A lunch break – it’s an important and often necessary part of our working or school day. It’s a chance to stop your tummy rumbling, grab a bite to eat and maybe chat with some friends. And now we’re spoilt with an array of places to buy our lunch from, all offering tempting dishes and humble sandwiches to eat on the go.

But our appetite for buying our lunchtime fare is not just costing us money, there might be a cost in terms of damaging our planet too. Just grabbing a sandwich, crisps and maybe a cake and coffee can produce at least four items of waste. Cartons, cups, wrappers and plastic cutlery are all part of our disposable feast in addition to the food waste we create. Some experts say throwing away food, which produces methane as it rots, is a bigger cause of climate change than plastics.

But regardless of what causes the most damage, the solution, according to an environmental campaign group called Hubbub, is to eat packed lunches. Tessa Tricks from the group says "People are saying that they are buying food to take out because life has got busier." And she says people think they are being more efficient; but she argues that it’s usually healthier and cheaper to make your own lunch. It means you can eat the things you really want and make the quantity that you actually need.

Of course, preparing your lunch is another thing to fit into your morning scramble of getting ready for work, so if you haven't got time and you are going to buy lunch, an alternative Hubbub suggests is to take your own container to a shop and ask them to put your food in it. The idea of using reusable coffee cups for hot drinks and refilling water bottles has already proved successful, so this could be another step in the right direction. A trial in East Anglia (in the UK) showed that offering a 10% price reduction did persuade some customers to come prepared with their own lunch box.

The problem with eating on the move is that you might want to carry your grub in something that is disposable, so it’s a good idea to make sure it’s something that is recyclable and not to take extra sachets of sauce or utensils that you’re not going to use. The message seems to be that if we give our lunchtime eating habits some thought, we can all do our bit in helping reduce climate change and damage to our environment. That is something for all of us to chew on!

vocabulary.entry: lunch break /lʌntʃ breɪk/ 午休；午餐时间
vocabulary.example: We get a 45-minute lunch break at work.
vocabulary.translation: 我们上班时有45分钟的午休时间。

vocabulary.entry: tummy rumbling /ˈtʌmi ˈrʌmblɪŋ/ 肚子咕咕叫
vocabulary.example: I could hear my tummy rumbling during the meeting.
vocabulary.translation: 开会时我能听到自己的肚子咕咕叫。

vocabulary.entry: grab a bite to eat /ɡræb ə baɪt tu iːt/ 随便吃点东西；简单吃点
vocabulary.example: Let's grab a bite to eat before the movie starts.
vocabulary.translation: 我们在电影开始前随便吃点东西吧。

vocabulary.entry: on the go /ɒn ðə ɡəʊ/ 忙碌的；边走边做的
vocabulary.example: She's always on the go, so she often eats meals on the go.
vocabulary.translation: 她总是很忙，所以经常边走边吃东西。

vocabulary.entry: lunchtime fare /ˈlʌntʃtaɪm feə(r)/ 午餐食物；午餐餐点
vocabulary.example: The café offers a variety of healthy lunchtime fare.
vocabulary.translation: 这家咖啡馆提供多种健康的午餐餐点。

vocabulary.entry: in terms of /ɪn tɜːmz ɒv/ 在……方面；就……而言
vocabulary.example: The project is successful in terms of both cost and time.
vocabulary.translation: 这个项目在成本和时间方面都很成功。

vocabulary.entry: disposable feast /dɪˈspəʊzəbl fiːst/ 一次性盛宴（指用大量一次性餐具的餐食）
vocabulary.example: That takeaway meal was a disposable feast with lots of plastic packaging.
vocabulary.translation: 那份外卖是一场“一次性盛宴”，有很多塑料包装。

vocabulary.entry: methane /ˈmiːθeɪn/ n. 甲烷；沼气
vocabulary.example: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas produced by rotting organic matter.
vocabulary.translation: 甲烷是腐烂有机物产生的强效温室气体。

vocabulary.entry: packed lunch /pækt lʌntʃ/ 自带午餐；盒装午餐
vocabulary.example: I usually take a packed lunch to work to save money.
vocabulary.translation: 我通常自带午餐上班，以省钱。

vocabulary.entry: fit into /fɪt ˈɪntu/ 融入；挤进（时间/日程）
vocabulary.example: I need to fit a workout into my busy schedule.
vocabulary.translation: 我需要把锻炼挤进繁忙的日程中。

vocabulary.entry: morning scramble /ˈmɔːnɪŋ ˈskræmbl/ 早上的匆忙；晨间忙碌
vocabulary.example: The morning scramble to get the kids ready for school is always chaotic.
vocabulary.translation: 早上忙着送孩子上学的过程总是乱糟糟的。

vocabulary.entry: reusable coffee cup /riːˈjuːzəbl ˈkɒfi kʌp/ 可重复使用咖啡杯
vocabulary.example: Many cafes offer discounts to customers who bring their own reusable coffee cups.
vocabulary.translation: 很多咖啡馆给自带可重复使用咖啡杯的顾客提供折扣。

vocabulary.entry: refill water bottle /ˌriːˈfɪl ˈwɔːtə ˈbɒtl/ 给水瓶加水；可重复加水的水瓶
vocabulary.example: I always carry a refill water bottle to avoid buying plastic bottles.
vocabulary.translation: 我总是带一个可重复加水的水瓶，避免买塑料瓶。

vocabulary.entry: price reduction /praɪs rɪˈdʌkʃn/ 降价；折扣
vocabulary.example: The store announced a price reduction on all summer clothing.
vocabulary.translation: 这家商店宣布所有夏季服装降价。

vocabulary.entry: eating on the move /ˈiːtɪŋ ɒn ðə ɡəʊ/ 边走边吃
vocabulary.example: Eating on the move is not good for digestion.
vocabulary.translation: 边走边吃不利于消化。

vocabulary.entry: recyclable /riːˈsaɪkləbl/ adj. 可回收的
vocabulary.example: Make sure you put the paper in the recyclable bin.
vocabulary.translation: 确保你把纸放进可回收垃圾桶。

vocabulary.entry: sachet of sauce /sæˈʃeɪ ɒv sɔːs/ 酱料包；调味包
vocabulary.example: The takeaway came with several sachets of soy sauce and chili sauce.
vocabulary.translation: 这份外卖配有几包酱油和辣椒酱。

vocabulary.entry: plastic cutlery /ˈplæstɪk ˈkʌtləri/ 塑料餐具
vocabulary.example: We should avoid using plastic cutlery to reduce waste.
vocabulary.translation: 我们应该避免使用塑料餐具以减少浪费。

vocabulary.entry: food waste /fuːd weɪst/ 食物垃圾
vocabulary.example: 食物垃圾是许多国家的主要环境问题。
vocabulary.translation: Food waste is a major environmental problem in many countries.

vocabulary.entry: do one's bit /duː wʌnz bɪt/ 尽自己的一份力
vocabulary.example: Everyone should do their bit to protect the environment.
vocabulary.translation: 每个人都应该为保护环境尽自己的一份力。

vocabulary.entry: chew on /tʃuː ɒn/ 认真思考；仔细琢磨
vocabulary.example: I need some time to chew on this idea before making a decision.
vocabulary.translation: 我需要一些时间认真思考这个想法，再做决定。

vocabulary.entry: humble sandwich /ˈhʌmbl ˈsændwɪtʃ/ 普通的三明治
vocabulary.example: A humble sandwich and a glass of milk make a simple lunch.
vocabulary.translation: 一份普通的三明治加一杯牛奶就是一顿简单的午餐。

sentences.english: A lunch break – it’s an important and often necessary part of our working or school day.
sentences.chinese: 午休——是我们工作或上学日中重要且通常必不可少的一部分。

sentences.english: It’s a chance to stop your tummy rumbling, grab a bite to eat and maybe chat with some friends.
sentences.chinese: 这是一个让肚子不再咕咕叫、随便吃点东西，或许还能和朋友聊聊天的机会。

sentences.english: And now we’re spoilt with an array of places to buy our lunch from, all offering tempting dishes and humble sandwiches to eat on the go.
sentences.chinese: 如今，我们有各种各样的地方可以买午餐，这些地方都提供诱人的菜肴和简单的三明治，方便我们边走边吃。

sentences.english: But our appetite for buying our lunchtime fare is not just costing us money, there might be a cost in terms of damaging our planet too.
sentences.chinese: 但我们购买午餐不仅花钱，还可能也在破坏我们的地球。

sentences.english: Just grabbing a sandwich, crisps and maybe a cake and coffee can produce at least four items of waste.
sentences.chinese: 仅仅买一份三明治、一包薯片，或许再加一块蛋糕和一杯咖啡，就会产生至少四类垃圾。

sentences.english: Cartons, cups, wrappers and plastic cutlery are all part of our disposable feast in addition to the food waste we create.
sentences.chinese: 除了我们制造的食物垃圾，纸盒、杯子、包装纸和塑料餐具都是这场一次性盛宴的一部分。

sentences.english: Some experts say throwing away food, which produces methane as it rots, is a bigger cause of climate change than plastics.
sentences.chinese: 一些专家表示，食物垃圾腐烂时会产生甲烷，它对气候变化的影响比塑料更大。

sentences.english: But regardless of what causes the most damage, the solution, according to an environmental campaign group called Hubbub, is to eat packed lunches.
sentences.chinese: 但无论哪种因素造成的破坏最大，环保运动组织“喧闹”（Hubbub）表示，解决方案是自带午餐。

sentences.english: Tessa Tricks from the group says "People are saying that they are buying food to take out because life has got busier."
sentences.chinese: 该组织的特莎·特里克说：“人们说他们买外卖是因为生活变得更忙碌了。”

sentences.english: And she says people think they are being more efficient; but she argues that it’s usually healthier and cheaper to make your own lunch.
sentences.chinese: 她还说，人们认为这样更高效，但她认为自己做午餐通常更健康、更便宜。

sentences.english: It means you can eat the things you really want and make the quantity that you actually need.
sentences.chinese: 这意味着你可以吃自己真正想吃的东西，并且做适量的食物。

sentences.english: Of course, preparing your lunch is another thing to fit into your morning scramble of getting ready for work, so if you haven't got time and you are going to buy lunch, an alternative Hubbub suggests is to take your own container to a shop and ask them to put your food in it.
sentences.chinese: 当然，准备午餐是你早上匆忙准备上班时又一件要做的事，所以如果你没时间自己做而要去买午餐，“喧闹”组织建议的另一种选择是自带容器去商店，让店员把食物装进去。

sentences.english: The idea of using reusable coffee cups for hot drinks and refilling water bottles has already proved successful, so this could be another step in the right direction.
sentences.chinese: 使用可重复使用的咖啡杯装热饮和给水瓶加水的想法已经被证明是成功的，所以这可能是朝着正确方向迈出的又一步。

sentences.english: A trial in East Anglia (in the UK) showed that offering a 10% price reduction did persuade some customers to come prepared with their own lunch box.
sentences.chinese: 英国东安格利亚的一项试验表明，提供10%的折扣确实说服了一些顾客自带饭盒。

sentences.english: The problem with eating on the move is that you might want to carry your grub in something that is disposable, so it’s a good idea to make sure it’s something that is recyclable and not to take extra sachets of sauce or utensils that you’re not going to use.
sentences.chinese: 边走边吃的问题在于，你可能想用一次性的东西装食物，所以最好确保它是可回收的，并且不要拿多余的、你不会用的酱料包或餐具。

sentences.english: The message seems to be that if we give our lunchtime eating habits some thought, we can all do our bit in helping reduce climate change and damage to our environment.
sentences.chinese: 这传达的信息似乎是，如果我们多想想自己的午餐习惯，我们都能为减少气候变化和环境破坏出一份力。

sentences.english: That is something for all of us to chew on!
sentences.chinese: 这是值得我们所有人认真思考的事情！
